original.target_description: Simple correlation between observer age and estimated age of the ambiguous woman across the final USA sample.

n.sample_role: Final-sample participants contributing observer age and estimated woman age to the simple correlation.
n.exclusions: USA final sample after attention checks, valid demographic responses and estimated woman age older than 18 years; non-USA respondents excluded. Recruitment: 666 overall, 418 USA; final USA sample 393.
n.location: Results, paragraph beginning “The relation between the observer’s age”, Figure 3 simple correlation; Method > Participants, final sample.

notes: Identity independently verified in canonical text: matching title Perception of an ambiguous figure is affected by own-age social biases; authors Michael E. R. Nicholls, Owen Churches and Tobias Loetscher; Scientific Reports 8, 12661 (2018); DOI 10.1038/s41598-018-31129-7. Primary published article with Method, Results and Discussion, not abstract-only. No PDF supplied; locations refer to canonical HTML sections. Replication side and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. Requested relationship is explicitly identified as simple correlation. N is explicitly the final sample with valid demographic and age-estimate responses, corroborated by printed r(393), not derived from df. No additional correlation-specific exclusions are described.
